stem:
Read these lines from the poem.

His suit became smellier day after day
His shoelaces frayed and his socks turned to gray.

The imagery used in these lines allows the reader to know that —

options.label: F
options.text: Bartholomew’s routine has been repeated for a long time

options.label: G
options.text: Bartholomew does not realize his clothes are getting old

options.label: H
options.text: Bartholomew’s clothes have been damaged by birds

options.label: J
options.text: Bartholomew works in a dirty environment

visual_elements: His suit became smellier day after day
His shoelaces frayed and his socks turned to gray.
